query: INSERT INTO sync_observations (indexer, deployment, network, latest_block, head_block, observed_at) SELECT * FROM UNNEST($1::text[], $2::text[], $3::text[], $4::bigint[], $5::bigint[], $6::timestamptz[]) ON CONFLICT (indexer, deployment) DO UPDATE SET network = EXCLUDED.network, latest_block = EXCLUDED.latest_block, head_block = EXCLUDED.head_block, observed_at = EXCLUDED.observed_at
